subject.title: [Feature]: Pre-reset agentic memory flush — /new and daily reset should get the same memory flush as compaction

question: Should reset-boundary memory preservation be a default/blocking agentic flush, a plugin/session lifecycle hook contract, or an external-memory/plugin responsibility?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the fix changes silent model execution, durable memory retention, reset latency, and security boundaries, so automation should not choose the product policy.

options.title: Design a core reset-memory policy
options.body: Define a timeboxed reset-boundary preservation contract for manual, daily, and idle rollover, then implement it with explicit security and config behavior.

options.title: Narrow to lifecycle hooks
options.body: Keep agentic flushing outside core and make `session_end`/`before_reset` plus bundled or external plugins own memory persistence.

options.title: Defer to external memory plugins
options.body: Leave core reset behavior unchanged and document that external memory systems such as world-model integrations own cross-reset continuity.

recommendation.title: Design a core reset-memory policy
recommendation.body: Define a timeboxed reset-boundary preservation contract for manual, daily, and idle rollover, then implement it with explicit security and config behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: The feature history ties both the original memory flush and daily reset defaults to this owner, and the remaining decision is a core memory/session product policy.
